why: The fourteen entries §36.3 governs, copied out of criteria.json before wave 1 could touch them. You cannot verify that something moved correctly without a record of what it was, and by the time p3-36 runs, eight plans will have merged and five of them will have edited these entries. phase1-frozen.json is not extended: it is a record of a different set at a different tree.

checks.test: perf::idle_scheduled_frames
checks.assert: Amendment 21: zero scheduled frames while unfocused or hidden, and at most one flicker element while focused, sampled over at least 60 s in the defined idle state.

measurement.run: at least 60 s with the shelf visible and focused, no project page open, no session open, no job running, and no pointer or keyboard input for at least 5 s

checks.test: AC-21 the scheduled flicker obeys its eligibility and its parameters
checks.assert: At most one card in the viewport — mounted is not enough; 1 to 2 sub-dips of 15 to 25% of steady glow, each 80 to 140 ms, a deterministic Poisson process at about 9 s mean seeded per session, suspended while unfocused and resuming with no backlog. Eligibility is condition_signal in {neglected, abandoned}, location present, is_reference = 0. The design's 50% depth, fixed 130 ms hold and fixed 9,000 ms period are cut and must not be asserted.

checks.reason: Amendment 21 marks the CPU figure provisional: the 0.014 to 0.017% in the probe results was taken before any scheduled frame existed, so it describes a different build. It is re-measured before the public beta rather than gated on now.
checks.assert: No idle CPU or GPU budget is gated in phase 1.

checks.reason: Asserting the app is absent from the OS audio mixer requires an OS audio mixer; no hosted CI runner exposes one, and a stubbed audio device would assert the stub.
checks.assert: The app does not appear in the OS audio mixer while idle.

checks.assert: Main database plus WAL under 100 MB against the fixture of 1,000 projects, 200,000 commit subjects and 100,000 events.

criteria.title: Every colour and every motion value resolves to a declared one

checks.test: check-forbidden:c46-colour-literals
checks.assert: The built stylesheet contains none of the four snapped grounds, none of the additional off-token ground, none of the off-token greys other than the condition-dot fills, and not the dropped blue. The language palette and everything the rasterizer computes are exempt by name and never reach a stylesheet.

checks.test: check-forbidden:c46-motion-values
checks.assert: The built stylesheet declares no duration literal and no timing function that the motion tables or a named single-effect row does not carry.

checks.test: AC-50 tier off runs zero animations and schedules zero frames
checks.assert: At reduced and off the scheduled flicker is absent — steady glow, no dip. Hazard tape renders identically and the pin mark is a static silhouette no tier deletes. Verified by resolving a style on a real element under each tier, never by matching the stylesheet's text: the clamp selects ten class names exactly and an eleventh name makes it select nothing. [p2] The number was nine and is ten: `.cdt-specular` joined the set when the sweep's clamp was corrected off `.cdt-plate`, and this assert was not raised with it — one value in two places, drifting, with the check `deferred` so nothing ever compared them. Measured against `motion.css`: cdt-bloom, cdt-bracket, cdt-card, cdt-card-halo, cdt-dot, cdt-pin-silhouette, cdt-plate, cdt-scanline, cdt-specular, cdt-strip.

checks.reason: The criterion is marked half in the spec: whether condition, tier, rank and safety remain readable from static form alone is a human reading, and absence of a condition dot is a correct static reading rather than a failure.
checks.assert: Condition, tier, rank and safety are readable at tier off.

checks.test: AC-58 the dot renders on all five surfaces from one table and emits no value outside it
checks.assert: A NULL condition_signal draws no dot at all on every surface; the not-indexed badge carries the state. Contrast is asserted per row, with the offline disc explicitly exempt. The project page's identity line draws exactly one dot and the page's hero draws band 1's, which is a different surface.

checks.test: acceptance_derive::ac_58_condition_day_edges
checks.assert: The mapping's day edges are exactly the stated ones and the design's colder boundary, the one edge this document does not carry, appears in none of them.

checks.test: check-forbidden:c58-design-band-names
checks.assert: The two design band names warm and cooling appear in no CSS class, query field, protocol message, log line or accessible name, over all three of criterion 58's target sets. blueprint is asserted absent as a condition_signal VALUE instead — by the DDL CHECK and the generated ConditionSignal union type, both structural (A4) — and is permitted as a rendition name and a tier token. The two enum words that look like band names are required verbatim and are not banned.
